svg.title: Krackhardt's advice network
svg.desc: The 21 managers drawn with a stress layout, circle area proportional to the number of managers who come to each one for advice.
svg.text: Circle area: number of managers who come to this manager for advice (4 to 18).
Orange: the three most asked (managers 2, 18 and 21). Lines: the 145 pairs with at least one tie; direction is not drawn.
